title: 琥珀色の記憶と、蒸気仕掛けの栞
author: 猫柳 すず

en.title: Amber Memories and the Steam-Powered Bookmark
en.premise: In the basement of the secondhand bookstore where I work lies a 'secret market' where people buy and sell memories they no longer need. One day, a young man visits the shop, claiming he sold something precious, but can no longer remember what it was. Guided by a mysterious bookmark tucked inside a book and the erratic ticking of the city's steam clock, what did he lose, and to whom did it go? A gentle tale of piecing together fragments of memory like a puzzle.

zh.title: 琥珀色的記憶與蒸氣裝置的書籤
zh.premise: 在我擔任店員的舊書店地下，有一個買賣人們不再需要的記憶的「秘密市場」。某日，一名青年來到店裡，說自己「賣掉了重要的某樣東西，卻想不起那是什麼」。透過夾在書中的不思議書籤，以及街道上蒸氣時鐘的紊亂，他究竟失去了什麼，又將其交付給了誰？這是一個將記憶碎片如拼圖般拼湊而成的，溫柔的故事。
